notes: Tested as viewer and editor: list page and totals (unfiltered and per category, arithmetic checked), category filter incl. bogus and script values, add/edit/delete as editor, server-side validation (negative, non-numeric, 1e400, whitespace title), stored XSS in title (escaped), viewer access control on new/edit/create/update/delete (all 403), unknown routes (404), login error copy, logout invalidating session, cookie flags, load times (about 20-60 ms). No defects that I would file were confirmed. Not tested: pagination (none seen), concurrency, accessibility beyond label checks, and visual layout beyond unstyled-but-readable pages. Test data was added and modified during the run (QA test item, edited Train to Pune amount to 0.00, deleted Printer paper).

cost.notes: estimate from 30084 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0003-$0.0036
